motive.zhHans: 他知道 Kobayashi 在案发当天没有不在场证明，并预料到 Kobayashi 因为在缓刑期间，很可能会自己编造一个不在场证明，于是他想出了这个计划，让 Kobayashi 成为最大的嫌疑人。小五郎开始推理，在柯南的提示下，他首先排除了 Kobayashi，因为他被指控伪造不在场证明，并被犯人所利用。然后他把 Keisuke Ban 排除在嫌疑人名单之外，因为 Ban 撒了谎，他实际上一直在纠缠 Kaede，纠缠得太厉害以至于被警察逮捕。他试图袭击 Kaede，但 Kaede 因为 Ban 的缘故去了拳击馆学习防身术，所以她自卫成功，并说早该这么做了。关门海峡之谜 为了到达本州并实施犯罪，犯人必须穿过关门海峡。证据 根据 Daiehara 的诊断书，他摔断腿至今已经两个月零十五天了。由于是用他们家传的锅煮的，食物一定浸透了鲜味，和泉屋的老板会认出来。
motive.en: He knew that Kobayashi didn't have an alibi on the day of the crime, and anticipated that Kobayashi will probably fabricate an alibi himself since he is on probation, he came up with this plan to make Kobayashi the biggest suspect. Kogoro starts his deductions, told by Conan, he first excludes Kobayashi because he was accused of faking his alibi and was utilized by the culprit. He then precludes Keisuke Ban out of the suspect list because Ban lied, he was actually stalking Kaede so persistently that he was arrested by the police. He tried to attack Kaede but Kaede went to a boxing gym to learn self-defense because of Ban so she defended herself from him and said she should have done it right from the start. The mystery of Kanmon Channel In order to get to Honshu, and implement the crime, the culprit has to go across the Kanmon Channel. Evidences According to Daiehara's medical certificate, it has been two months and fifteen days ever since he broke his leg. Since it is cooked using their heirloom pot, the food must be steeped in the umami flavor, that the Izumiya restaurant owner will recognize.

method.zhHans: 他知道 Kobayashi 在案发当天没有不在场证明，并预料到 Kobayashi 因为在缓刑期间，很可能会自己编造一个不在场证明，于是他想出了这个计划，让 Kobayashi 成为最大的嫌疑人。小五郎开始推理，在柯南的提示下，他首先排除了 Kobayashi，因为他被指控伪造不在场证明，并被犯人所利用。柯南指出，从 Daiehara 发给小五郎作为不在场证明的照片来看，他手腕上戴的是潜水电脑表，而不是普通手表。由于是用他们家传的锅煮的，食物一定浸透了鲜味，和泉屋的老板会认出来。而且两人都坚持说那道菜是用那口锅煮的。
method.en: He knew that Kobayashi didn't have an alibi on the day of the crime, and anticipated that Kobayashi will probably fabricate an alibi himself since he is on probation, he came up with this plan to make Kobayashi the biggest suspect. Kogoro starts his deductions, told by Conan, he first excludes Kobayashi because he was accused of faking his alibi and was utilized by the culprit. Conan pointed out that from the photo Daiehara sent to Kogoro for his alibi, he was wearing a dive computer on his wrist rather than a normal watch. Since it is cooked using their heirloom pot, the food must be steeped in the umami flavor, that the Izumiya restaurant owner will recognize. And both of them insisted that the dish was cooked using that pot.

evidence.zhHans: 因此，Daiehara 的诊断书可能并非有力的证明。看到真相被揭露，Daiehara 坦白了罪行，并决定毁掉那口锅。
evidence.en: Therefore, Daiehara's medical certificate may not be a vigorous proof. Seeing the truth being revealed, Daiehara confesses and decides to destroy the pot.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Satoru Daiehara。他教唆 Yasushi Kobayashi 在两年前实施了那起盗窃，这样一来，就会给他提供一个合适的动机。他知道 Kobayashi 在案发当天没有不在场证明，并预料到 Kobayashi 因为在缓刑期间，很可能会自己编造一个不在场证明，于是他想出了这个计划，让 Kobayashi 成为最大的嫌疑人。小五郎开始推理，在柯南的提示下，他首先排除了 Kobayashi，因为他被指控伪造不在场证明，并被犯人所利用。然后他把 Keisuke Ban 排除在嫌疑人名单之外，因为 Ban 撒了谎，他实际上一直在纠缠 Kaede，纠缠得太厉害以至于被警察逮捕。Ban 利用了 Kaede 的善良，没有把事情闹到警察那里。他试图袭击 Kaede，但 Kaede 因为 Ban 的缘故去了拳击馆学习防身术，所以她自卫成功，并说早该这么做了。
resolution.en: The culprit is Satoru Daiehara. He instigated Yasushi Kobayashi to commit the theft two years ago, this way, it will offer him a suitable motive. He knew that Kobayashi didn't have an alibi on the day of the crime, and anticipated that Kobayashi will probably fabricate an alibi himself since he is on probation, he came up with this plan to make Kobayashi the biggest suspect. Kogoro starts his deductions, told by Conan, he first excludes Kobayashi because he was accused of faking his alibi and was utilized by the culprit. He then precludes Keisuke Ban out of the suspect list because Ban lied, he was actually stalking Kaede so persistently that he was arrested by the police. Ban took advantage of Kaede kindness not turn it into a police matter. He tried to attack Kaede but Kaede went to a boxing gym to learn self-defense because of Ban so she defended herself from him and said she should have done it right from the start.
